text:
jay: Heads-up: on the streaming canary for albatross-int4 were seeing a specific class of structured-output failures related to arrays split across streaming chunks. Rate up from ~0.9% to ~3.4% on the funcall/sequence suite.

natalie: can you paste a raw chunk trace?

jay: sure, here's a trimmed example (chunks arrive in order):
```
chunk 1: {"tools":[{"name":"scan","result":{"items":[{"id":1,"text":"ok"},"  
chunk 2: {"id":2,"text":"fine"}]}}],"meta":{"cursor":"abc"}
chunk 2 arrives appended to previous payload but closing array bracket sometimes dropped or a trailing comma inserted by model quantized outputs -> final payload invalid JSON
```

omar: ah that explains the parser errors weve been alerting on (Unexpected token "," / EOF while parsing array). Are we sure it's generated by the model versus a streaming concat bug in the runtime?

jay: diff between fp16 and int4: fp16 streams always balanced; int4 has ~3x more split-boundary anomalies. Also observed extra trailing comma inserted before chunk boundary in many failed samples.

natalie: hypothesis: quantization jitter nudges tokenization so that the model emits "," as a separate token at the end of a chunk rather than with the next item start — combined with chunk framing we end up with dangling commas or unclosed arrays.

ci-bot: Alert: albatross-int4 streaming_array_balance_fail_rate=3.4% (baseline=0.9%) on suite/streaming-funcalls.

jay: proposed mitigations (short/medium/long):
- short: implement a stream reassembly guard in the structured-output layer that increments a bracket/balance counter and buffers until balanced or a size/time threshold hit. Also collapse trailing commas if they would make JSON invalid.
- short: add a per-request streaming sentinel header (x-struct-sentinel: [[STRUCT-START]] / [[STRUCT-END]]) that the model is asked to include at chunk boundaries for canary runs for easier reassembly.
- medium: if parsing still fails after reassembly, trigger cheap fp16 fallback for that request (rate-limited). Record fallback count in telemetry.
- medium: add sanitizer that normalizes repeated commas/escaped sequences and normalizes unicode punctuation at final reassembly step.
- long: investigate token-level logits floor / token-bias tuning for int4 so commas don't become sticky at chunk tails.

omar: agree on buffering + trailing-comma-collapser as immediate stopgap. But we must be careful not to mask other classes of regressions; telemetry needs to track raw_stream_invalid, reassembled_valid, repaired_by_collapser, and fallback_fp16.

natalie: also add a tiny streaming unit in the onboarding golden set: intentionally split arrays at many byte offsets to simulate chunk boundaries and ensure reassembly logic recovers. Store these in suite/streaming-boundary-goldens.

jay: action items: 
- jay: implement stream reassembly + trailing-comma collapse behind feature-flag, attach metrics (PR target: 2h)
- omar: add golden cases and run canary with sentinel header enabled (job id streamcanary-172345-1)
- natalie: add telemetry dashboard and gating rule: block canary if raw_stream_invalid > 1% and repaired_by_collapser < 40% over 30m.

ops-bot: Job streamcanary-172345-1 queued. ETA ~15m.

ci-bot: Update: streamcanary-172345-1 finished. raw_stream_invalid=3.3%, reassembled_valid=1.9%, repaired_by_collapser=42%, fallback_fp16_triggers=0.8% (rate-limited).

omar: the collapser recovered ~42% which meets our temporary threshold but not great. Fallback_fp16 small but non-zero.

jay: next steps: 1) roll the feature-flaged reassembly to Hosted canary cohort; 2) run token-bias int4 recompile with softer logits floor (omar will schedule); 3) expand streaming goldens with diacritics and emoji-only arrays since those had higher failure rates.

natalie: also ensure metrics preserve visibility: do NOT dedupe reassembled successes into the canonical pass metric used for gating; keep raw failures visible so we can track model health and not hide regressions.

jay: noted. I'll include the raw/repaired split in the PR and keep the flag scoped to 48h with auto-turnoff if repaired_by_collapser < 30% after 24h.

omar: scheduling recompile: job id int4-bias-rebuild-172345-2. ETA 45m.

ci-bot: Reminder: please add unit tests for bracket-balance buffering and trailing-comma collapse to prevent regressions in the sanitizer itself.

natalie: will add tests and a short postmortem checklist in case fallback_fp16 exceeds 1% over a day.

jay: thanks team. If recompile helps we can deprecate the sentinel header and keep reassembly as a safety net. Will follow up with diffs and a short demo tomorrow.

ops-bot: Update: int4-bias-rebuild-172345-2 queued.
